protocol: held-out split, preregistered 2026-10-09 before any run
shot_schedule: shots_for(n, q): round-robin over classes k = c % 4, taking candidate j = len(out)//4 from the class-k pool; identical to the dev source (test_baseline_remaining.py / test_l1_adaptive_beta3.py)
excerpt: 260 characters of the passage text (the actual receipt7 source behaviour; its '48-token' label misdescribed it)
prompt_format: Passage: <excerpt> -> <letter>\n ... then 'Passage: <excerpt> -> ' ; competitor letters a/b/c/d must be single tokens (asserted)

arms.energy: beta3 repaired arm, seed 101, 60 Adam steps, trained on the DEV pool (24 passages) — training set identical to the dev protocol; evaluation on the held-out queries only
arms.direct: same architecture and training, direct (non-energy) update, seed 101
arms.competitor: Qwen3-0.6B (596M, frozen, in-context shots, CPU, float32) — the best measured same-size competitor on the dev fixture (37.5% max, receipt7)

baselines.majority_pool_constant: predict the shot-pool-majority class for every held-out query
baselines.no_retrieval_energy_head: trained energy arm with the retrieval feature set to zero
baselines.no_retrieval_direct_head: trained direct arm with the retrieval feature set to zero

acceptance_threshold.A1_energy_at_8_shots: energy arm accuracy on the held-out set at 8 shots >= 0.50 (>= 4 of 8)
acceptance_threshold.A2_beats_best_competitor: energy arm at 8 shots strictly > Qwen3-0.6B at 8 shots on the same held-out queries
acceptance_threshold.A3_beats_no_memory: energy arm at 8 shots strictly > no-retrieval energy head at 8 shots
acceptance_threshold.A4_per_class_coverage: at 8 shots, at least 1 correct in EACH of the 4 classes (anti-single-class guard)
acceptance_threshold.rule: ALL four must hold to claim held-out superiority. Any failure is published as a negative result; the numbers are reported verbatim either way.
